subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: May ClawSweeper implement a narrow trusted-official propagation fix for recorded official ClawHub installs discovered as workspace-origin, while keeping raw workspace plugins and `plugins.allow` installs untrusted?
rationale: The expected behavior follows the existing trusted-official plugin contract, but the exact predicate decides which external plugin code receives persistent state and channel ingress APIs.

options.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
options.body: Trust only candidates whose official catalog identity, install record, ClawHub metadata, and resolved path all match, and add denial tests for untracked workspace plugins.

options.title: Hold for broader trust model
options.body: Keep this issue blocked behind the wider external-plugin trust design even though the report has an official install record.

options.title: Keep current denial
options.body: Leave official user-extension installs without keyed state access until they load through an already-supported origin, accepting that this WhatsApp install shape remains blocked.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow provenance fix
recommendation.body: Trust only candidates whose official catalog identity, install record, ClawHub metadata, and resolved path all match, and add denial tests for untracked workspace plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: They already gave related trust-model guidance and have adjacent workspace trust-boundary history, so they are the best available owner for the security-boundary choice.
